title: CLO 2025.1 - Upgraded 3D Pen
description: CLO 2025.1 new version fully upgraded to further enhance your work efficiency! The upgraded 3D pen in the new version allows you to draw garment outlines directly around virtual models in 3D space and instantly convert them into 2D patterns.
transcript:
This video introduces the upgraded 3D pen virtual model function and its related feature updates.  
First, you can draw in the area outside the model.  
You can directly draw the clothing version in the 3D environment without having to start from the 2D version.  
You can not only draw curves on the model surface, but you can also freely draw in the surrounding 3D environment.  
This makes it easier to build complex three-dimensional outlines.  
Now let's re-create the outline of the chest according to the reference clothing.  
You can directly see how to use the function after upgrading.  
First, select the 3D pen virtual model tool.  
When you select it, a line of hints will appear next to the light.  
You can simply click on the model to place it.  
Press the P key to create a template outside the model surface.  
In this example, I will start from the model surface, then extend outward to create a three-dimensional skirt.  
Let's start by using the 3D pen.  
Draw a curve along the model's body.  
Now let's draw the 3D version.  
Here I will press the P key.  
As shown, this function allows you to copy the model and freely extend the line into the 3D environment.  
At the same time, a guide point will appear so you can directly check the X, Y, and Z axes.  
It is easy to determine the position of each expansion point.  
Blue represents the Z axis, red represents the X axis, and green represents the Y axis.  
Just like drawing on the model, when you are drawing in the 3D area,  
you can also press the Ctrl key to draw a curve.  
To improve accuracy, when you are drawing in the 3D environment, you can also press the Shift key.  
This will constrain the angle to 45 degrees in the 3D window.  
This will create 8 guide points.  
Your view and mouse cursor will automatically align with these guides.  
This allows you to draw more accurately in the 3D environment.  
Once you release the Shift key, the guide will disappear.  
Next, press the D key to show a curve and display the actual distance between the mouse pointer and the model.  
Press the D key again to close this function.  
When you have completed the drawing in the 3D area,  
click the point where you first drew and the area where you drew.  
Click and press the 3D pen to display the tool.  
Then select the flat version tool.  
A tool will appear next to your cursor.  
It will prompt you to select the area to be generated and press the return key.  
Select a section of your version and press the return key.  
In this way, a flat version will be generated in the 3D window.  
You can see it simultaneously in the 2D window.  
Using the upgraded 3D pen virtual model function,  
you can directly draw in the 3D area outside the model and the model itself.  
It allows you to draw faster during the design process  
and combine multiple dimensions to create the flat version you want.  
It helps you create the complex design you imagine more easily.  
Next, I will introduce  
other advantages of the 3D pen virtual model.  
First, you can use the 3D pen virtual model tool  
to select lines in the 3D window by pressing the drag and drop button.  
Of course, you can also use the shortcut Ctrl + A to select all lines.  
The next update is that  
in the 3D line menu, when you press the right mouse button,  
an option to display length will be added.  
After pressing the cancel option in the blank area, the length display will not show and will only display when selected.  
If you need to hide it,  
you just need to perform the same operation to hide the measurement length.  
The next update is that the 3D-painted line can be copied to the edge of the grid.  
This function allows the 3D pen line to be automatically copied along the virtual model grid path.  
To improve the accuracy and speed of creation or adjustment of the version,  
when using this option,  
the line will align with the nearest grid edge.  
Next, I will introduce the function of the 3D pen virtual model.  
Now, in addition to being able to 3D-paint multiple sheets at a time,  
you can also merge them into one.  
First, select multiple closed areas.  
Press the return key directly.  
You can see that multiple sheets have been sewn together in the 2D window.  
Delete the sheet.  
Now, when I operate again,  
you can see that the 3D pen is now 3D.  
You can see the tool prompt.  
You need to press the Shift and return keys.  
At this time, there is only one sheet in the 2D window.  
This improvement greatly simplifies the work of converting the 3D block into a 2D sheet,  
speeding up the process and reducing manual operations.

chunks.title: CLO 2025.1 - Upgraded 3D Pen
chunks.content: ## Overview of CLO 2025.1 Upgraded 3D Pen Virtual Model Function This section introduces the upgraded 3D pen virtual model tool in CLO 2025.1, highlighting new capabilities such as drawing outside the model, enhanced 3D curve creation, and multi-dimensional version generation. These features improve design speed and complexity handling by integrating 3D and 2D workflows. ## Drawing in and Outside the 3D Model Environment The upgraded 3D pen allows users to draw directly on the model surface or freely in the surrounding 3D space, enabling the construction of complex three-dimensional outlines without starting from a 2D version. This supports more intuitive and flexible clothing design. ### Procedure to Create a 3D Outline 1. Select the 3D pen virtual model tool. 2. Click on the model to place the initial point. 3. Press the **P** key to create a template point outside the model surface. 4. Draw a curve along the model, then extend it outward into the 3D environment. 5. Use guide points that display the X (red), Y (green), and Z (blue) axes to accurately position expansion points in 3D space. ### Drawing Controls for Accuracy - Press **Ctrl** while drawing to create curved lines. - Press **Shift** to constrain angles to 45 degrees, activating 8 guide points that align the view and cursor for precise drawing. - Release **Shift** to remove guides. - Press **D** to toggle a display showing the distance between the mouse pointer and the model, aiding spatial awareness. ## Generating Flat Versions from 3D Drawings After completing the 3D outline: 1. Click the starting point and the drawn area. 2. Click and hold the 3D pen tool to bring up options. 3. Select the flat version tool. 4. A prompt appears to select the area to generate. 5. Select the desired section and press **Return**. 6. The flat version is generated and simultaneously displayed in both the 3D and 2D windows. This process allows designers to combine multiple dimensions and create accurate flat patterns quickly. ## Additional Features and Improvements in the 3D Pen Virtual Model ### Line Selection and Length Display - Lines in the 3D window can be selected by dragging (drag-and-drop) or by pressing **Ctrl + A** to select all lines. - Right-clicking in the 3D line menu now offers an option to display the length of selected lines. - Length display appears only when a line is selected and can be toggled off by clicking cancel in an empty area or repeating the operation. ### Automatic Alignment to Grid Edges - 3D-painted lines can now snap automatically to the nearest edge of the virtual model grid. - This feature improves accuracy and speeds up version creation or adjustments by aligning lines precisely with the grid. ### Multi-Sheet 3D Painting and Merging - Users can paint multiple closed areas simultaneously. - After selecting multiple closed areas, pressing **Return** merges these sheets. - The merged sheet appears sewn together in the 2D window.

chunks.content: ### Automatic Alignment to Grid Edges - 3D-painted lines can now snap automatically to the nearest edge of the virtual model grid. - This feature improves accuracy and speeds up version creation or adjustments by aligning lines precisely with the grid. ### Multi-Sheet 3D Painting and Merging - Users can paint multiple closed areas simultaneously. - After selecting multiple closed areas, pressing **Return** merges these sheets. - The merged sheet appears sewn together in the 2D window. - To simplify further, pressing **Shift + Return** merges multiple 3D sheets into a single 2D sheet. - This enhancement reduces manual work and accelerates converting 3D blocks into 2D patterns. ## Summary The CLO 2025.1 upgrade to the 3D pen virtual model tool significantly enhances the design workflow by enabling freeform 3D drawing both on and off the model surface, precise control over curve creation, intuitive measurement displays, grid snapping, and efficient multi-sheet merging. These improvements allow designers to create complex, accurate clothing patterns faster and more easily, bridging 3D modeling and 2D flat pattern generation seamlessly.
